Delete a package, a version, or a Docker image or tag

Delete what the coordinates name: a package (every version of it), or one
version when the coordinates carry a version. For Maven a group alone deletes
the whole group; for Docker, image deletes the image and image:tag the tag (a
digest cannot be deleted from the panel).

rp asks for confirmation on a terminal. In a script pass --yes; with --no-input
or without a terminal, and no --yes, the command exits 2 and deletes nothing.

The delete cannot be undone.

Packages are named in the natural coordinates of the repository's format:

```
maven   group[:artifact[:version]]        com.acme:app:1.2.0
npm     [@scope/]name[@version]           @acme/ui@2.0.0   (@acme alone: a scope)
docker  image[:tag] | image@digest        team/app:1.0     (image may contain "/")
go      module/path[@version]             example.com/mod@v1.2.3
cargo, helm, nuget, pypi, ruby   name[@version]
```

The format is read from the repository; pass --format to skip that request.

```
rp package delete <coordinates> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --format string     Repository format (default: read from the repository)
      --platform string   Ruby gem platform of the version (for example java)
      --repo string       Repository name (required)
```
